verdict.rationale: Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol spec explicitly describes an HTTP 402 flow where a merchant/server can request payment via 402, present a signed 'payment IOU,' and grant access pending settlement — a genuine machine-payment mechanism agents could use to pay per call without a checkout UI (visa-ic-supp-7). However, this is a single, thin mention embedded in a broader checkout/TAP spec rather than a dedicated API-monetization product, with no tutorial, SDK, or code sample specifically for per-call API monetization, and no independent evidence anyone has implemented this pattern for API billing. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation/tutorial for 402-based API monetization, concrete code/SDK examples of per-call agent payments to a generic API (not just merchant checkout), and independent corroboration of real-world usage.
